steps.en: The check before the 3rd letter follows the reminder step
steps.id: Pengecekan sebelum surat ke-3 menyusul langkah reminder
steps.why_en: The check runs by date, not after the reminder result, and the reminder job itself is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan jalan berdasarkan tanggal, bukan setelah hasil reminder, dan job reminder sendiri mati di produksi.

steps.en: NRIC drivers are sent to MHA for the latest particulars
steps.id: Driver ber-NRIC dikirim ke MHA untuk data terbaru

steps.en: Foreign-ID and company drivers are checked through DataHive
steps.id: Driver ID asing dan perusahaan dicek lewat DataHive
steps.why_en: That check is switched off in production, so only NRIC drivers are actually checked.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan itu dimatikan di produksi, jadi hanya driver ber-NRIC yang benar-benar dicek.

steps.en: New particulars are saved for the current driver only
steps.id: Data terbaru disimpan hanya untuk driver saat ini
